description: Monthly budget and rent ranges in US dollars for the cities Transita profiles, filtered by country or city. Figures are editorial estimates from public sources, each with its review date and sources. Use them for orientation, then check local listings.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. 'Berlin' or 'new-york'.

country.description: Lowercase destination country code, e.g. 'de', 'ca' or 'uk'. 'gb' also works for the UK.
